meta_description: Connect Decorators Leicester. Professional interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating. Free quotes, reliable local service.
hero_eyebrow: Expert Decorators — Free Quotes, No Pressure
hero_subhead: Transform your home with skilled decorators who listen to your vision and deliver flawless finishes every time.
services_subhead: From interior repaints to full exterior transformations, we handle every decorating job with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decoration
services.desc: Refresh your living spaces with expert interior painting, feature walls, and complete room makeovers. We prepare surfaces properly and use premium finishes that last.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Protect and enhance your home's exterior with weather-resistant exterior paint and rendering work. Our team prepares timber, brick, and render to ensure a durable, attractive finish.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Precise wallpaper hanging on any surface, from traditional patterns to modern feature walls. We measure, match, and hang with no visible seams or air bubbles.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, frames, and built-ins painted to a professional standard. Includes sanding, undercoating, and gloss finishes that protect and beautify.

services.title: Commercial Painting Services
services.desc: Offices, retail spaces, and industrial units painted on schedule and within budget. We work flexibly around your business hours to minimise disruption.

services.title: Specialist Finishes & Effects
services.desc: Textured coatings, paint effects, chalkboard finishes, and bespoke colour matching. Create the exact look you want with expert technique.

about_pullquote: Good decorating changes how a home feels. We take pride in getting it right.
about_para_1: Connect Decorators was founded on a simple idea: that homeowners deserve decorators who show up on time, listen carefully, and deliver results that match the quote. Over 12 years, we've built our reputation on Leicester by doing exactly that — treating every property, from terraced houses to listed buildings, with the same care and attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our painters and decorators are trained in modern techniques and traditional methods alike. We prepare surfaces properly, use quality materials, and always protect your home and belongings. Many customers return to us for repeat work, and we're proud that word-of-mouth referral now accounts for most of our jobs.

reviews.text: Had Connect Decorators in to repaint the lounge and hallway. Really professional job — they moved furniture carefully, kept the mess to a minimum, and the finish is perfect. Would definitely recommend them.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: I was nervous about getting the feature wall wallpapered, but the lads explained everything clearly and it looks stunning. They were tidy, friendly, and finished on time. Great value too.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Exterior paint job on a Victorian terrace is no small task, but Connect made it look easy. They sorted the prep work properly and the new colour has completely transformed the front. Very impressed.
reviews.author: Lisa M.
